ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-1: Zero-price bypass in validateHandlerOrder. computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow, validateHandlerOrder does not check sqrtPriceX96==0 unlike _validatePricingBounds
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: When sqrtPriceX96==0, the min bound check (0 < min) catches it if minSqrtPriceX96 is set. Only bypasses maxSqrtPriceX96 when minSqrtPriceX96==0. Impact limited to CLOB order placement bounds, not direct fund extraction. This is a view-only function called by CLOBTransferHandler._enforceTokenHooks. No extraction path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-2: Direct handler call bypassing pricing enforcement. CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer and PermitTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer check msg.sender==AMM
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Both handlers enforce msg.sender==AMM at the top of ammHandleTransfer. CLOBTransferHandler line 230, PermitTransferHandler line 115. No executeSwap function exists in the CLOB handler. The only swap-related function accessible externally is openOrder which calls _enforceTokenHooks for pricing. Direct handler calls are blocked.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-3: Settings sync gap between CLOBTransferHandler and CreatorHookSettingsRegistry. memSettings vs storage sync
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CreatorHookSettingsRegistry.setTokenSettings writes full memSettings to storage before syncing to hooks. The sync path sends the fully formed settings. No desync possible. This is CP-005 -- gas waste only (redundant storage reads), no security impact.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-4: Transient storage leak in DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT. beforeSwap writes but does not clear on all paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Confirmed as HOOK-001/CP-001 (known Low severity). The transient slot is written in _validatePricingBounds for direct swaps and read in afterSwap. Stale data only affects next direct swap in same transaction. For pool-based swaps, sqrtPriceX96 comes from pool type, not transient storage. No AMMHooksTransferHandler contract exists in the codebase (referenced in prompt but not in source).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H1: Malicious pool type returns fake amounts to steal from LPs
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Core validates at multiple levels: (1) pool type address must have 6 leading zero bytes, (2) returned poolId must encode correct poolType+fee, (3) actualAmountOut > originalAmountOut reverts (AMMModule.sol:1559-1562), (4) balance check verifies actual token movement (AMMModule.sol:2206-2213). _safeDecrementUint128 catches amountOut > reserves.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H2: Malicious transfer handler skips actual transfer, core believes funds arrived
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule._finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse (line 2206-2213) checks balanceInBefore + swapCache.amountIn != balanceInAfter, reverts with LBAMM__TokenInTransferFailed. Handler MUST actually transfer tokens or core reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H3: Malicious hook manipulates price limits to extract from swappers
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fee returned by _executeSwapHook is checked in _applySwapByInputInputFees (AMMModule.sol:2616): if feeAmount > swapAmountIn reverts with LBAMM__InsufficientInputForFees. Also, hook settings are controlled by token creator (self-inflicted config), and swappers are protected by limitAmount slippage check.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H4: Register pool type at address with 6 leading zero bytes to collide with legitimate type
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool type address requires 6 leading zero bytes (48 zero bits), leaving 112 bits of address space. Mining a collision via CREATE2 requires 2^112 work -- computationally infeasible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H5: UUPS takeover before initializer runs
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: SecureProxy is EIP-1967, not UUPS. Upgrade requires TIER_ADMIN pause + SECURE_PROXY_ADMIN_ROLE. No uninitialized implementation risk.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H6: Diamond selector collision -- deploy facet with colliding selector
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: LimitBreakAMM is NOT a diamond with dynamic facets. All selectors statically defined. Modules accessed via delegateCallPure with immutable hardcoded addresses. No addFacet/removeFacet functionality.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H7: CREATE2 redeploy different code at same trusted address
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: No selfdestruct in scope. Solidity 0.8.24 deprecates selfdestruct. Even if destroyed, pool type address must have 6 zero bytes.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H8: Storage slot collision across diamond facets
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Slither get_storage_layout confirmed all 4 modules (AMMModule, ModuleAdmin, ModuleFeeCollection, ModuleLiquidity) have 0 local storage slots. All state goes through LBAMMStorage at diamond slot 0x9A1D. No collision possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H9: Exploit facet management to add malicious facet without governance
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: No facet management exists. Module addresses are immutable constructor args in LimitBreakAMM. No upgrade path for modules.
INV-SW03: Rounding favors protocol. Each swap rounds against the user via mulDivRoundingUp. 100 swaps of 1 wei each lose dust TO the pool. Attacker cannot extract via repeated tiny swaps.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forged hook caller -- call hook directly with fake pool identity
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All state-changing hook functions verify _requireCallerIsAMM(): beforeSwap (L110), afterSwap (L159), validateAddLiquidity (L253), validateRemoveLiquidity (L366), validatePoolCreation (L320), validateCollectFees (L386). validateHandlerOrder is view-only (no state changes, no value extraction).

HOOK-001/CP-001 known Low severity. Transient slot only used for pricing bound enforcement in direct swap path. Stale data from path A read in path B within same TX. No extraction path -- bounds enforcement protects users, stale bounds can only make the check tighter or looser by one swap's amount.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Permit mutation -- replay signature with mutated unsigned fields (feeOnTop, recipient)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: SWAP_TYPEHASH includes recipient, amountSpecified, limitAmount, tokenOut, exchangeFee. feeOnTop is NOT signed (intentional). But limitAmount caps total input amount, so executor setting feeOnTop=max still cannot exceed limitAmount. Previously submitted and rejected (submission #8).

All 4 core modules have 0 local storage slots (confirmed by Slither). All use diamond storage at 0x9A1D. Hooks and handlers are separate contracts (external calls), not diamond facets sharing storage. No collision vector.
